info.name: TrustUs Health Portal Backend
info.description: Backend API organized by feature. Set baseUrl and adminEmail, request an OTP, then verify it; the access token is saved automatically. Refresh tokens use Postman's cookie jar. Patient Registry folders are numbered in the order they should be run. Business Insights (INS1, INS2) is Admin only. BG covers Spectrum bill generation and Metropolis bill editing.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Request an OTP, retrieve it from Mailpit/Gmail, then set otpCode and verify. The verify script saves accessToken; the refresh cookie is stored by Postman's cookie jar.

request.description: 202 is returned whether or not the account exists. Check Mailpit or the Gmail inbox for the actual message.
Set otpCode to the six-digit code received by email. A refresh cookie is also set.
Uses the HttpOnly tu_refresh cookie saved by Postman. The response includes a new access token; the cookie rotates automatically.
Revokes the refresh-token session and clears the refresh cookie. Clear accessToken manually after testing if desired.

item.name: BG - Bill Generator (Spectrum and Metropolis)
item.description: Bill Generator API workflow. All endpoints require a signed-in user with bill_generator access and access to the selected lab. Start with List available bill-generation labs. Spectrum: create an entry (or parse a report first), get prefill, save bill data, render. Metropolis: inspect the original PDF, then render it with one amount per row. Use the same Metropolis PDF for inspect and render. Preview/download responses are PDFs; email delivery returns {sent:true} and sends only to the signed-in user's email. Metropolis replaces the internal bill number with the lab's number while retaining bill_no_original; conflicts return 409.

request.description: Returns only laboratories this user can access in Bill Generator. Admin sees all configured bill-generation labs.
Select a Spectrum report PDF (or another configured allowed upload type). This reads the report in memory; it does not save an entry. The response contains parsed fields and duplicate hints.

Creates or merges an entry for a generated Spectrum bill. Change the sample identity/date before rerunning to avoid an unintended duplicate. Exact matches can return 200; new entries return 201; duplicate decisions return 409.
Returns the entry fields and bill data needed to prefill the bill page. Run after creating an entry or set billEntryId manually.

exec: pm.test('Bill prefill belongs to selected entry', function () {

request.description: Updates test amounts, discount, lab cost and/or client name on the same entry. expected_version is optional; supply it for optimistic concurrency protection. Money values are decimal strings.

Returns a PDF for preview/download, or {sent:true} when delivery=email. Email is sent only to the currently signed-in user. Set delivery to preview, download or email. Optional bill_discount_amount overrides the saved discount for this bill only; use 0 to omit the discount block, or null to use the saved discount. The override is never stored.

Select the original Metropolis bill PDF. Read-only: extracts the lab bill number, patient, rows and totals, and checks matching entries and whether the lab bill number is already owned. Nothing is saved.

Select the same original Metropolis PDF used for inspection. Form fields: amounts is a JSON array with one decimal string per test row; lab_cost is optional; delivery is preview/download/email. force_new=true explicitly creates a distinct entry when a possible patient match exists. The endpoint verifies the edited PDF before saving test amounts and replacing bill_no with the lab number; existing entry financial fields are unchanged. A lab bill number owned by another entry returns 409 bill_no_taken; repeated processing of the same bill is idempotent.
